# The Taste Gym

> A gym for musical taste. Instruments that measure David Hume's five criteria of taste
> ("Of the Standard of Taste", 1757) as numbers, using performance tasks where the user can be
> wrong — never self-report, never personality prediction. Everything is free: there is no paid
> tier. Scores are honest: results are labeled provisional until real cohort norms exist, and no
> percentile is ever fabricated.

Three instruments are live. The flagship is the Prestige Test: rate sixteen short music clips
blind, then rate the same clips again with artist names attached — fourteen carry artist names,
two of the fourteen labels are deliberately false, and every swap is disclosed in a mandatory
debrief. The blind-vs-labeled rating gap is a measured prestige-bias number; the user serves as
their own control. The Delicacy Trials play damaged and undamaged pairs and ask which is which.
The Threshold Test adapts until it finds the smallest flaw a listener can still hear, and reports
that size in cents, milliseconds or kbps. All scoring is deterministic code — no AI classifies the
user.

## Core pages

- [The Taste Gym (home)](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/): what the gym is; the three machines
- [The Prestige Test](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/bias): the flagship instrument — about eight minutes, free, no sign-up
- [The Delicacy Trials](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/delicacy): three practice trials with answers shown, then fifteen scored pairs
- [The Threshold Test](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/threshold): an adaptive staircase reporting a sensitivity threshold in physical units
- [Reading room](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/learn): all explainers — the five criteria, the instruments, the methodology
- [Naming what went wrong](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/learn/flaws): the three flaw families the instruments measure — what each sounds like in a render, the unit it is measured in, and which machine measures it
- [What is the Prestige Test?](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/learn/prestige-bias-test): the design, the sanctioned deception, the debrief
- [Methodology](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/learn/methodology): performance tasks, within-subject control, deterministic scoring, honest-norms policy
- [The Lab](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/lab): the analytics surface — metric dictionary, instrument health, parameter recovery, measured limits

## Hume's five criteria (one explainer each)

- [Delicacy](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/learn/delicacy): the key-in-the-wine story; the Delicacy Trials and the Threshold Test both measure it
- [Practice](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/learn/practice): why taste is trainable; measured by the retest arc, which compares a device against its own earlier sittings; live
- [Comparison](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/learn/comparison): Ogilby vs. Milton; breadth as degrees used, measured from the Prestige Test's own ratings; live
- [Freedom from prejudice](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/learn/freedom-from-prejudice): the criterion the Prestige Test measures
- [Good sense](https://vibe-check-app-sepia.vercel.app/learn/good-sense): calibration — confidence vs. accuracy, Brier scores
